question: How is the Lord's visarga described as the play of creation and dissolution?
premises: Mere visarga belongs to the Lord.
It manifests as the play of creation and dissolution.
It is the Lord casting his own self into his own self.
inference: Visarga is the Lord's self-reflexive act that appears as creation and dissolution.
plain_english: Mere visarga is the Lord's play of creation and dissolution: it is the casting of his own self into his own self, the state belonging to visarga.
